review: 701.43b-1: forge_notes claimed exerting twice is unreachable; it is reachable (vigilance plus an additional combat) but has no observable contrast, and the note now says so.

skipped.reason: An object can only be exerted as an attack cost or as part of an ability cost paid on the battlefield, so no two-player Forge game offers to exert an object in another zone; nothing can be illustrated.

scenarios.title: An exerted permanent does not untap during its controller's next untap step
decisions: A attacks B with Ahn-Crop Crasher, exerting it; its trigger targets Ahn-Crop Crasher; the trigger resolves.
B has no blockers; combat damage is dealt. The rest of A's turn passes.
B passes through B's turn without acting.
A's next turn begins and A's untap step is performed.

variants.label: exerted
variants.expected: Combat damage leaves B at 17. After A's next untap step Ahn-Crop Crasher is still tapped.

variants.label: not_exerted
variants.delta: A attacks without exerting Ahn-Crop Crasher (no trigger).
variants.expected: Combat damage leaves B at 17. After A's next untap step Ahn-Crop Crasher is untapped.

scenarios.title: A permanent that is not tapped can be exerted

setup.notes: Cathar's Shield gives the equipped Crasher vigilance, so it stays untapped when it attacks.

decisions: A attacks B with Ahn-Crop Crasher, exerting it; its trigger targets Ahn-Crop Crasher; the trigger resolves. Ahn-Crop Crasher stays untapped.
B has no blockers; combat damage is dealt. The rest of A's turn passes.
In B's upkeep B activates Icy Manipulator with the Island, tapping Ahn-Crop Crasher. B's turn otherwise passes.
A's next turn begins and A's untap step is performed.

variants.label: exerted_untapped
variants.expected: Ahn-Crop Crasher attacks without becoming tapped. After A's next untap step it is still tapped.

variants.label: not_exerted
variants.delta: A attacks without exerting Ahn-Crop Crasher (no trigger).
variants.expected: After A's next untap step Ahn-Crop Crasher is untapped.

scenarios.forge_notes: Only the not-yet-tapped branch of 701.43b is exercised. Exerting twice before one untap step is reachable (vigilance plus an additional combat), but it has no observable contrast: both effects expire at the same untap step either way.

scenarios.title: A creature exerted as it attacks fires its linked when-you-do trigger
decisions: A attacks B with Ahn-Crop Crasher and chooses whether to exert it as shown in each variant. If exerted, the trigger targets Grizzly Bears and resolves.
B blocks Ahn-Crop Crasher with Grizzly Bears if able; combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: exerted
variants.expected: The linked trigger fires and Grizzly Bears cannot block this turn. Ahn-Crop Crasher is unblocked, B is at 17, and both creatures are undamaged.

variants.label: not_exerted
variants.delta: A attacks without exerting Ahn-Crop Crasher.
variants.expected: The trigger does not fire. Grizzly Bears blocks: Ahn-Crop Crasher (3/2) deals 3 damage to Grizzly Bears and Grizzly Bears deals 2 to it. Both creatures die. B is at 20.
